integrity.statement: The main finite-volume transform and asymptotic claims are supported by an explicit analytic operator proof; finite checks corroborate but do not certify infinite limits. The historically known first-order mean is credited. No independence or external certification is claimed.

scientific_limitations: Applies to the exact canonical order-polytope coordinates of a perfectly alternating odd fence. The affine snake correspondence does not preserve this observable. The first-order peak-clearance mean is already implied by published one-coordinate sampling results. Independent validation and broader bibliographic verification remain open; the finite checker is diagnostic.
title: Exact tilted spectrum and Gaussian peak-clearance fluctuations in zigzag order polytopes
